build.beforeDevCommand: bun run sidecar && bun run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: bun run sidecar --release && bun run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:*; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: Run local AI models on your own computer.
bundle.longDescription: Fonsviva finds a model that fits your computer, downloads and runs it, shows its real speed, and connects it to T3 Code, Local Studio and any OpenAI-compatible app in one reversible click.
